arm_groups.label: compressed tablet of safoof e muhazzil

brief_summary: The purpose of this clinical trial is to study the comparative effect of a classical unani antiobesity drug safoof-e-muhazzil on hyperlipidemia in its classical powder form and in compressed tablet form against a standard control.
brief_title: Clinical Study to Evaluate Antihyperlipidemic Effect of a Classical Unani Antiobesity Formulation

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 20 Year(s) To 70 Year(s)
* Gender Both
* participate in Clinical Trial voluntarily.
* Hyperlipidemic

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons below 20 yrs and Above 70 yrs of age
* Pregnancy
* Liver diseases
* Renal diseases
* Diabetes mellitus Type II
* Alcoholic
* AIDS
* Thyroid Disease
* Drug intake ? Corticosteroids, Diuretics, Beta-blockers, Oral contraceptives, Cyclosporin, Androgens \& Retinoids

interventions.name: compressed tablet of safoof e muhazzil

official_title: Clinical Study on Hyperlipidemia and Comparative Evaluation of Efficacy of a Compound Unani Formulation (Safoof e Muhazzil) and Compressed Tablet of Safoof e Muhazzil in Its Management
